BiblicalUsage: Sheber was a son of Caleb by his concubine Maachah, named in the genealogy of Judah, and that is all Scripture says of him. His name means breaking.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a one-line name belongs in the record. Sheber is counted among the sons of Caleb, and I hold that God keeps the names of the overlooked.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
